text_block_list.text:
At Симболи Рудольф's request, I
accompany her to a
shrine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Listen to that silence.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The air itself seems pure somehow. I feel
as
though it's cleansing me from the
inside out.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Constantly questioning ourselves...
Striving to do
our best... These things
drive us forwards.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But as we forge ahead, our feet grow
dirty and
our eyelids heavy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That's why it's important to visit places
like this
from time to time. So that we
may empty our
minds and return to
whence we began.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But there I go again, lapsing into a
lecture.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Shall we head to the altar?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Phew! Now that blew the cobwebs away.
I feel
light in body and soul.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And what's more, with the benefit of a
clear mind,
I can see the answer to a
thorny problem I was
wrestling with.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Quickly, back to the academy! I must
commit this
to paper!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We approach the altar and put our
hands
together, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late! There was this lost kid at
the
station...
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're such a Goody Two-Shoes!
We're on
a schedule here—keep with the
tempo!
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text: Hmmm...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Tempo... tent pole...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Tent pole... temple... shrine? Aha!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Oho... I just thought of something rather

marvelous.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Agh!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Caw! Caw!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: A crow suddenly swoops down at us!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer! Are you hurt?!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Thank goodness.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Still, that felt rather like a warning from
the shrine
itself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I suspect it was chiding me for getting
distracted
while praying and making a
joke of its name.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Well, it may rest assured that I have
learned my
lesson.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Our tranquil outing has an unexpectedly

foreboding ending.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф seems to have perked up

considerably. The shrine visit must have
done her
good.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
